LOOK: River Warriors from the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) collect trash from the Pasig River on Tuesday, June 10.

This initiative is part of an anti-flood campaign aimed at clearing waterways to prevent urban flooding during the rainy season.

 📷: John Louie Abrina | MB
